title: Evaluating Dialect Robustness of Language Models via Conversation Understanding

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM performance on Target Word Prediction (TWP) and Target Word Selection (TWS) tasks using masked transcripts of the 'Taboo' word-guessing game in US English versus Indian English.

Conducting an error analysis to identify prediction failures caused by a lack of 'Shared Cultural Context', measuring the models' inability to understand culturally shared notions and references specific to Indian English speakers.
